I absolutely love this cleanser I've already bought it 3 times. Since it's oily it leaves my skin moisturized instead of using other cleaners striping all the oils off my face. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Love the product, not the smell so much.

avis.titre: I buy this over and over
avis.texte: This is the only oil cleanser I use. It removes my black eyeliner and mascara without effort. I follow this with the Byoma Creamy Jelly Cleanser, and my dry skin feels good.

I cleanse with this first then cleanse again after i wash it off with a differant face wash and it does a great job at removing makeup. Only complaint is it doesnt get super bubbly on the face but thats understandable since it is a oil cleanser.

avis.titre: THE best!! Doesn't dry out my skin!

I like using this product at first, but after a week or two my skin care started to burn after I washed my face at night. Even when I was just putting on moisturizer. I thought it was my cleanser at first so I switched it, but stayed using the Byoma oil cleanser. I thought it was weird my skin care didnt burn in the mornings after I washed my face, and not at night. Then I realized the only difference between my morning and night time skin care routine was the Byoma oil cleaner.

I purchased this because I wanted to try something new. I read the directions several times and I still feel like I didnt read them correctly. If I would remember, I would have 10000% returned this product. It gets everywhere. I can only use this before showering b/c it splatters. Not worth it. I have somewhat sensitive skin and this stuff works great for me. Not drying, but leaves my skin feeling clean. The rosemary scent is earthy and doesn't bother me in the slightest. Will definitely purchase again.

avis.titre: I would not recommend or repurchase

avis.titre: Best Drugstore Oil Cleanser on the Market
avis.texte: Title says it all. Feels like prestige with a drugstore price tag. I'm obsessed.

I've been double cleansing with an oil or cream cleanser since 2017 and this is my favorite and most affordable, and I've tried no joke dozens of them high end and drugstore. I love that this one is easily accessible too since I use it daily to remove sunscreen as well as face and eye makeup. No eye residue or stinging, doesn't break me out, and smells mildy of rosmary oil as its used as an antioxidant in the formula.

avis.titre: high end feel for a drugstore price!!
avis.texte: my skin is so oily its insane. i tried this on a whim because it had olive oil in it and my skin loveddd that. it's genuinely one of the nicest oil cleansers ive tried & it removes mascara alot easier (esp compared to some lighter weight kbeauty cleaning oils) for the price, definitely i see myself buying this on repeat!

So, I have all of the skin probs. Like all of them lol. I get psoriasis patches (mild thankfully), I am acne prone, my skin is getting dryer as I get older, and I have sensitive skin on top of all of this. This keeps my skin clear without drying it out. I do use other products to keep acne away and a really good moisturizer as well but anyway, I like the way my face feels after I've rinsed this off. It makes my face feel really soft and clean. I was worried at first because oil isn't really your best friend if you are acne prone but I can't use a lot of face washes that combat acne because they eventually will dry me out and then the psoriasis patches pop up. This shockingly does not make me break out, my face is really clear, it does not make me look shiny/oily, and it just gently cleanses my face. I have strayed from this face wash before to try others and I can confirm this is the best one for me and I don't think I'll be using any other face wash ever again after trying out other products and comparing them to this one. This face wash is awesome!!!!

avis.titre: Works great in double cleanse routine

I do follow up with the milky moisture cleanser after just to make sure it's all off my skin. I dont feel stripped or dry after. I wouldnt use it twice a day (I justbuse the milky moisture cleanser in the morning). Will be repurchasing - the bottle is about hapfway through after a month of nightly use.

Maybe my pores just need something more extreme. It didnt no me any harm, but it hasnt done me any benefit either.

The smell is horrible. It doesnt remove waterproof mascara hardly at all. I have to go in with an eye makeup remover to remove the rest of my eye makeup. Other than that its just ok. Not any better than my go to cleansing oils.

avis.titre: perfect for those with sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Gentle, Hydrating, and Perfect for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I received complimentary from byoma the BYOMA Milky Oil Cleanser, and it's been a game-changer for my skincare routine. This cleanser has a luxurious, milky texture that effectively removes makeup and impurities without stripping my skin of moisture. What sets this product apart is how gentle it is while still providing a thorough cleanse. My skin feels hydrated and soft after each use, and I love that it's suitable for sensitive skin. The clean, natural ingredients make me feel confident that I'm using something both effective and kind to my skin. It also emulsifies easily with water, making it a breeze to rinse off, and it leaves no oily residue behind. This cleanser is perfect for anyone who wants a lightweight, non-irritating, and nourishing formula for their skincare routine. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a gentle, hydrating cleanser that leaves the skin feeling fresh and clean!

Okay, so let's talk about the Byoma Milk Oil Cleanser. First off, the packaging? Major aesthetic vibes—super cute and minimal. The blend of oils and milks feels so luxurious but doesn't leave you greasy, which is a total win. It melts away makeup like magic, and honestly, my skin feels so soft and hydrated after. No tightness or dryness here! (Gifted by byoma)

The cleanser is very liquidy when dispensed. It doesn't really remove makeup well and doesn't lather. I felt like I needed to wash my face a few times with this product to properly cleanse my skin. The worst part is the smell. It has a very strong chemical scent but it does disappear after you wash it off. Gifted by BYOMA.

I've been using this Milky Oil Cleanser for a few weeks now, received complimentary from byoma. The texture is silky and smooth, effortlessly gliding over the skin. With water, it transforms into a milky consistency that rinses off clean without any residue. While I don't wear heavy makeup, this cleanser has been excellent at removing sunscreen, tinted moisturizer, and daily grime. It has a subtle, almost licorice-like scent. Personally, I prefer a more aromatic cleansing experience to make the routine feel extra special, but if you're looking for a gentle, no-fuss option, this one could be the one for you.

This is my new favorite morning cleanser. For reference I am oily and acne prone. I use this in the mornings and this leaves my face feeling clean and not stripped. No tightness at all. Also it didn't leave any kind of residue. I haven't tested this on makeup yet but I have a feeling this might be good for the 2nd cleanse. Gifted by Byoma

Really good cleanser, used it for about two weeks and it's helped me achieve a good moisturized look, although it did seem to break me out a bit :( but it still works wonderful! It's not a runny cleanser it actually stays put. Little to no fragrance which is always wonderful. (Gifted by byoma)

I really love the brand Byoma and their milky products are fantastic, I highly recommend this line! It's also super affordable and feels great on the skin! Highly highly recommend trying it out! Love it! Offered by byoma

Gifted by BYOMA. I've tried this a handful of times and I've been impressed so far. It has not stung my eyes like other oils have and it did a great job getting rid of my makeup with very little wipe after.

Gifted by Byoma - the cleansing oil feels luxurious and melts off all of my makeup effortlessly! I love how I can find this from the drugstore easily. The price point is also great! This is great for double cleansing.

What really impressed me is how nourishing it feels—my skin is left feeling soft, moisturized, and not stripped at all. It's perfect for my sensitive, acne-prone skin because it's gentle and doesn't clog my pores. Plus, the added benefit of the barrier-boosting ingredients has made my skin look more radiant and balanced after consistent use. This cleanser has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine, especially for double cleansing. Gifted by Byoma.

I absolutely love this oil facial cleanser offered by Byoma! This product is so easy to use and make my skin feel so clean and fresh! I also love the packaging! I would definitely recommend this product!
